name: Default
use_case: Any department, until a use-case template is picked for it.
floor: Admits each new row into the queue with its origin: typed in chat, the schedule, a stamped proposal, or a hand-off.
Orders the queue and names the next item; never runs work itself.
Holds the budget: work beyond the budget line waits and becomes an ask.
Never reads a check to set pay, budget or rank: a check is a check, never a score.
choices: Which waiting item to raise first when the budget is short.
reads: The queue and each row's origin.
The budget line and what has been spent against it.
may_propose: A change to the budget line, filed to Identity.
Dropping or deferring a queued item.
A new due date for a work item.
schedule: On every new row, and each morning before the first run.
checks: Every row in the queue has an origin.
Nothing ran past the budget line without a stamped ask.
